notes: Comprobación del inglés de la voz elegida. Las frases nuevas copian literal frases fijas del catálogo aprobado en User Stories, salvo en-confirm, que repite la frase de la primera escucha que sacó 1 en 'misma persona'. La referencia es una frase en español de la misma voz; el control es un audio en inglés de otra voz, que debe sacar 2 o menos para que los puntajes cuenten. Los audios de la primera escucha dicen la apertura anterior ('This call is recorded'): spoken_in_first_run guarda lo que dicen, para que el texto de la página coincida con el audio.

spoken_in_first_run.en-opening: Hi, this is Valentina, Sunmeadow Auto's AI assistant. This call is recorded so I can file your case correctly. I can help you report a claim or answer questions about your policy, and if at any point you'd rather have a person review your case, just say so. First, is everyone okay?
spoken_in_first_run.en-confirm: Got it: Highway 9, exit fourteen, around five thirty in the afternoon. Is that right?

texts.text: Got it: Highway 9, exit fourteen, around five thirty in the afternoon. Is that right?

texts.text: Let me check your policy, one moment.
I can't find a clause in your policy about that, so I won't guess. I'll flag it for the adjuster.
If someone is seriously hurt, call your local emergency number now. This is a demo and can't send help.
An adjuster reviews your case; the decision will show up on this screen. Sunmeadow, four, eight, two, nine, one, three.
Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you say it again?
